description:
Activate Mimic Vat, making a token copy of Floodchaser which enters as a 0/0 with six +1/+1 counters.
Go to combat, moving all counters from Ozolith onto Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours, removing all +1/+1 counters on it, gaining an extra turn.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your end step, the Floodchaser token triggers, exiling itself.
The Ozolith triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.
